messages:
laura-partners: Quick check-in: Databricks Partner Connect validation for our Vector Connector (Pinecone + Redis + Weaviate adapters) is scheduled next week. Also exploring GCP Marketplace listing for connector package. Who owns the Partner Connect manifest and cloud billing examples? Need to coordinate docs + partner assets.

ethan-eng: I can own the Partner Connect manifest + sample notebooks. Status: adapter adapters/pinecone + adapters/redis + adapters/weaviate all have smoke tests passing. Need to add the OAuth flow stub for Partner Connect and a simple CLI install. ETA: 3 days.

priya-legal: FYI, GCP Marketplace has a different contract flow vs Databricks. We'll need a lightweight MSA addendum and a data-processing appendix for connectors that move vectors off-cloud. Can @laura-partners capture which adapters handle customer vectors outside their cloud region?

laura-partners: Good point. Pinecone and hosted Weaviate deployments may cross regions depending on customer config; Redis can be deployed inside customer VPC. I'll make a table of data residency options per adapter and share.

cal-marketing: For Partner Connect we need 1) short landing page + 2) 3-step quickstart notebook + 3) 1-min demo gif. Also ask Databricks for a partner quote. If we're on GCP Marketplace, need an icon, short description, and legal logo approvals. Can we get assets by 2026-04-02?

ethan-eng: Pushing a PR: databricks/partner-connect/manifest.yaml and examples/notebooks/vector-search-demo.ipynb. Manifest includes the UI tile, oauth redirect, and one-click deploy instructions. Snippet below for the manifest section:
```yaml
partnerConnect:
  name: "Redwood Vector Connector"
  publisher: "Redwood Inference"
  redirectUri: "https://app.redwood.dev/databricks/callback"
  integrations:
    - pinecone
    - redis
    - weaviate
```

dave-sre: Heads up on infra: GCP Marketplace listing will require us to provide a reproducible deployment (Terraform + GCR image). We'll need a hardened image for the connector runtime and an IAM service account spec. SRE can template the terraform but need final image tag.

laura-partners: Action items: Ethan owns manifest + notebooks (due +3 days). SRE templates terraform and image policy (dave). Legal to draft addendum (priya). Marketing to prepare assets (cal). I'll coordinate with Databricks PM to schedule the validation session for 2026-04-05.

cal-marketing: Also propose a joint tiny webinar "Vector Search from Lakehouse -> Redwood -> Vector DB" — 20 min + partner spotlight. If Databricks partner team is game, we can slot it in their partner webinar series. Need to know if we get co-marketing funds.

priya-legal: I'll start the draft addendum. Quick Q: do any adapters persist raw user data in our logs? If so we need to add redaction and retention controls to comply with partner requirements.

ethan-eng: No adapters persist raw payloads in logs by default. We have an opt-in debug flag that collects vector samples; I'll add a note and make debug off by default in the Partner Connect image.

deploy-bot: CI: partner-connect branch build #9134 passed :white_check_mark:. Nightly canary job scheduled (canary: partner-connect-canary at 02:00 UTC).

laura-partners: Excellent. One more ask: for GCP Marketplace, they want a short pricing SKU example. Can sales provide a baseline unit? (cc @dave-sre for billing integration).

dave-sre: We'll add a sample pricing SKU JSON to the terraform templates. Sales, if you can provide a recommended starter tier, we'll bake it in.

laura-partners: Ok team — plan recap posted to partnership tracker and I've scheduled a 30-min validation dry run on 2026-04-03. Please attach PR links and assets before EOD 2026-03-31. Thanks! :rocket:
